content.caption: Stacked bar charts of Answer Agent F1, B1 (BLEU-1) and J (LLM-as-a-Judge) scores before RL and after PPO and GRPO training. Panel (a) uses a Llama3.1-8B-Instruct memory manager and panel (b) a GPT-4o-mini memory manager; RL gains are larger in (b).
content.description: Two side-by-side stacked bar charts. Panel (a) is subtitled 'Llama3.1-8B-Instruct' and panel (b) 'GPT-4o-mini'. According to the page caption, these name the Memory Manager paired with the Answer Agent. Each panel has the y-axis label 'Score in %' with ticks at 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70 and 80. The axis starts at about 15, not zero. There are three x-axis categories: F1, B1 (BLEU-1) and J (LLM-as-a-Judge score). A legend at the upper left of each panel maps blue to Before RL, red to PPO and green to GRPO. Each bar is a stack: the blue segment rises from the axis bottom to the Before RL score, a red segment sits on it up to the PPO score, and a green segment on top reaches the GRPO score. Each segment's top edge is therefore that method's score, and the green top is the cumulative total height of the stack. No numbers are printed. All values below are estimated axis read-offs at each segment's top edge, given as blue / red / green. Panel (a): F1 ~27 / 34.5 / 37.5; B1 ~20.5 / 28 / 30.5; J ~48 / 49 (a very thin red band) / 53. Panel (b): F1 ~31 / 46 / 51; B1 ~25 / 37 / 43.5; J ~56 / 65 / 72. In both panels and all three metrics, PPO raises the score above Before RL and GRPO adds a further gain, so GRPO is always highest. J is the highest-scoring metric and B1 the lowest. Every bar in (b) is taller than its counterpart in (a), including the Before RL baseline. The RL gains are also much larger in (b). From Before RL to GRPO, (a) gains about +10.5 F1, +10 B1 and +5 J, while (b) gains about +20 F1, +18.5 B1 and +16 J. The smallest increment is PPO on J in panel (a), at about 1 point.
